scope: Independent opt-in streaming TTT component only; preserve original HybridPilot, CKB/FORGE and original science owners.
hypothesis: A bounded explicit external fast-weight state can produce chunk-by-chunk exact read-before-write continuity with the original TTTLinearMemory over the same sequence; reset-per-call loses past fast state. Candidate-only previews never write.

limits.confirmed_mask: all bool true required; caller confirmation is NOT independently source-authenticated
limits.cold_storage: weights+tensor state only, no arbitrary pickle

tests.segmented_equivalence: torch.allclose(original full-sequence TTT output, concat(stream chunks + query), atol=1e-6, rtol=1e-6) across deterministic two batch sizes and seeds
tests.reset_negative: cold chunk2 loses fast state and produces measurably distinct prediction, no false equivalent claim
tests.preview_purity: candidate order inversion same-state predictions unchanged, repeated preview identical, count and weights unchanged
tests.atomic_invalid: malformed shape, false confirmed mask, nonfinite, wrong dtype/device, count overflow rejected without mutation
tests.cold_replay: weights_only tensor checkpoint and reconstructed core produces torch.equal output and state
tests.differentiability: training opt-in source learning remains differentiable on observed facts with grad
tests.param_overhead: no new trainable params, core weights shared
tests.source: hand-authored CPU tensor examples only; no protected new science or heldout draws
tests.source_qualification: original full Windows/WSL final regression required before acceptance

science: STREAMING_RESTORE_ENGINEERING_PASS_NE_NATIVE_INTELLIGENCE_OR_CAUSAL_TRANSFER; independent actions/outcomes and strongest baseline benefit not qualified
